evidence_scope: Real trial and approval facts; every economic input below is an illustrative research assumption.

approval_gate.before_status: Illustrative sensitivity anchor, not a historical analyst probability or calibrated prediction
approval_gate.after_status: Realized historical US ATTR-CM approval decision, not probability of commercial success

assumption_notes.paid_patient_years: Illustrative annual treated-and-paid patient-years for this indication only; not new starts, eligible prevalence or company reported counts.
assumption_notes.price: Illustrative net realized annual revenue; not list price or observed commercial net price.
assumption_notes.fcf_conversion: Illustrative after-tax unlevered FCF/revenue after recurring delivery, sales/administration, reinvestment and working capital; those items must not be deducted twice.
assumption_notes.upfront: Illustrative incremental committed launch expenditure at valuation date, paid regardless of the approval gate. Historical R&D is sunk and excluded.
assumption_notes.discount: Illustrative discount rates; approval risk is applied once through the explicit gate, not again through a separate clinical PoS multiplier.
assumption_notes.scenario_weights: Conditional commercial assumptions, independent of the approval gate in this exercise; not empirically estimated probabilities.
assumption_notes.horizon: Seven annual end-period cash flows only. No terminal value or cash flows beyond 2032; no conclusion about actual exclusivity/patent cliff.
assumption_notes.counterfactual: Before and after are held at the same valuation date and economic assumptions to isolate the historical approval gate; this is not a return backtest.

market_implied.status: NEEDS_DATA; no verified ALNY equity bridge or market price is supplied.
